verdict.rationale: Postmark is a hosted email SaaS, and nothing in the evidence shows its service source code published under an open license. The official client SDKs (postmark-docs-21) and an official MCP repo on GitHub (postmark-comm-4) are adjacent artifacts, not the product's own source, and no license terms are given for them.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
